props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value (uncontrolled), with the same number or array shape as `value`; its shape
also sets the shape that `onValueChange` and `onValueCommit` receive. Defaults to `min`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
`Intl.NumberFormat` options used to format the raw value (not its share of the `min`-`max`
range) for the displayed value text and `aria-valuetext`, using the provider locale. A
`percent` style multiplies by 100, so pair it with a `0`-`1` range. A `valueLabel` function
takes precedence for the displayed text.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's labelable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to with
`for`. Most controls set it on their focusable element and `PinInput` on its first slot;
`Slider` and `FileUpload` set it on their hidden native input. `CheckboxGroup` and
`RadioGroup` set it on their `<fieldset>`, which the `Field` label names through
`aria-labelledby` instead of `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's
related parts (root, hidden input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it
unique on the page.

props.name: inputRef
props.description:
Ref to the hidden native `<input type="range">` of the first thumb, which submits its value.
The focusable thumbs are separate `<div role="slider">` elements.

props.name: label
props.description:
Content shown at the start of the track. Also used as the default `aria-label` when it is a
string. It renders in both the track and fill text layers, so pass JSX inline rather than a
shared node.

props.name: markers
props.description:
Visual markers on the track. `true` marks every `step` and shows none when `step` is `0`.
A number marks every that many units without affecting snapping.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value of the slider.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value of the slider.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Focus event when focus leaves the slider, called before the `Field` blur notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus event when focus enters the slider, called before the `Field` focus notification.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called on every value change during interaction (pointer drag, track click, or key press),
with the new value in the same shape as `value`. Does not fire for programmatic changes to
`value`. Use `onValueCommit` to react once per finished interaction.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description:
Called once an interaction that changed the value finishes: when the pointer is released,
when a navigation key is released, or when focus leaves the slider. Receives the final value in
the same shape as `value`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: reversed
props.description:
Reverses the track direction, so `min` sits at the right (or top when vertical) instead of
the left (or bottom) in left-to-right layouts.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description:
Step increment between values; pointer and keyboard values snap to multiples of it from `min`.
A value of `0` (or not above `0`) keeps the slider continuous: pointer movement is smooth
and arrow keys move by 1% of the range. `PageUp`/`PageDown` and `Shift` + arrow move by
about 10% of the range.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized message overrides for this slider instance: `thumb` returns each thumb's
`aria-label` and `valueText` returns its `aria-valuetext`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The current value (controlled). A number renders one thumb and an array renders one thumb per
entry (an empty array gives one thumb at `min`). Values are clamped to `min`-`max` and
arrays are sorted. Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled usage. The slider throws a
`RangeError` when `max` is not greater than `min`.

props.name: valueLabel
props.type: boolean | ((props: { percent: number; value: number; max: number }) => string)
props.description:
Controls the value text shown at the end of the track. `false` hides it, `true` shows the
number, and a function returns the text to show. The function receives the current `value`,
the `max` (100 when not set), and `percent`, the filled share of the track from 0 to 100.
With `true`, the value is formatted with `formatOptions` when set; otherwise it is rounded to
the decimal places of `step` (2 places when `step` is `0`) with no digit grouping.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Fill treatment. `subtle` uses a solid neutral fill (`muted-active`), so the label, value, and
indicator keep the same colors over the fill and the track. `solid` uses the primary color
and switches the label, value, and indicator to `primary-foreground` over the fill.
